qrel_derivation.rule: Same required product AND process AND non-simulation constraint AND no exclusion flag AND required format => grade by fact count:3=>3,2=>2,1=>1,0=>0. Any hard mismatch=>0. Exact=>3 iff authoritative target, else0. Ambiguous explicit process map. Noanswer0.

metadata_variation.completeness: Omit optional contact/license/temporal/spatial coverage in25-50%; retain title,description,publisher,queryContext,claim evidence and required distributions.
metadata_variation.distribution_rule: Retain every required format; multiple formats may share a documented downloadable bundle. Extra distributions repeat supported facts only. >=30% records have>1 distribution.
metadata_variation.publishers: At least12 synthetic institutions; orthogonal to labels; reassigned perseed.
metadata_variation.quality: Primary quality=1 and hasQuality=true, fixed per stable ID across all seeds. Neutral isolation, not production-quality realism. Separate fixed per-ID quality stress only for correctness; relevance invariant.
metadata_variation.queryContext: Only actual searchable evidence; never labels or target query text. Honor distribution-only and title-only identifier scope.
metadata_variation.seed_streams: Independent deterministic PRNG per(seed,stable_id); no ranking feedback. Seeds vary prose, word order, length, optional fields, publishers and distribution allocation, never identity/claims/qrels.
metadata_variation.spatial: Primary no geographic preference; generic spatial stress local fixtures only; labels invariant.
metadata_variation.synonym_absence: All grade>=2 positives omit listed absent_positive_tokens in all searchable strings, case-insensitive whole tokens; express facts using other natural language.
metadata_variation.target_lengths: short45-75,medium90-140,long160-220;>=20% records in each band perseed
metadata_variation.variation_acceptance: >=60% records description wordcount differs>=10 between two seeds;>=30% distribution count differs; no identical title template used>5 times; claims and required formats unchanged.

systems.only_delta_from_baseline: remove root dataset vector boost50 only; all nested vector, keyword, quality and spatial scoring unchanged

embedding.repository_revision: not independently verified; disclose limitation; pin image and cached-vector hashes

runtime.mapping: production mapping/analyzers exported and hashed identically across systems
runtime.search_builder: actual production builder, evaluation-only export adapter

generation_boundary: Requirement plan only, NOT searchable corpus. B starts only after main verifies all7 architecture-file hashes.
